title: Add provision-to-ready dashboards and alert rules
author: Sergio Costa
body:
Title: Add provision-to-ready dashboards and alert rules

Summary
This PR adds the first cut of Grafana dashboards + Prometheus alert rules for the Provision-to-Ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management). The goal is to make time-to-ready (TTR) and failure modes visible by region/GPU type/step, and to establish initial paging/ticketing thresholds that we can tune during staged rollout.

What’s included
- Dashboards (Grafana)
  - Provision-to-Ready / Overview: P50/P95 time-to-ready, success rate, in-flight counts by readiness state, and top failure reasons
  - Step breakdown: per-step durations (P50/P95), retries, and "stuck" detection views for Provisioning vs Validating
  - Failure heatmap: failure rate by region x gpu_type, and failures by step (GPU health, driver parity, kubelet join, NCCL smoke, perf canary)
  - Quarantine & flakes: quarantine counts over time, validation flake rate, and "recovered after retry" vs "quarantined" split
- Alerts + recording rules (Prometheus)
  - SLI-oriented alerting for time-to-ready and success rate (windowed)
  - Early rollout guardrails to avoid paging for known flakes; pages only on sustained SLO breaches
  - Recording rules to standardize TTR percentiles and keep dashboard queries cheap
- Runbook link stubs
  - Each alert includes an annotation with the runbook doc location and a "next steps" snippet (what to check first: step breakdown panel, failure reason panel, quarantine panel)

Metric assumptions / dependencies
- Assumes control-plane is emitting the canonical metrics (names match the latest proposal in ENG-4821). This PR does not add application metrics; it consumes them.
- Expected series dimensions:
  - region (low cardinality)
  - gpu_type (A100/H100/L40S/etc.)
  - pool_type (dedicated/shared)
  - step (bounded set)
  - result (success/failure)
- Explicitly NOT using node_id/instance_id labels in any alerting expression or dashboard variables. (We learned this the hard way in prior fleet dashboards; node-level drill-down should be via logs/traces, not Prom labels.)

Dashboards (panels / key queries)
- Time-to-ready (TTR)
  - Uses histogram_quantile over fleet_provision_time_to_ready_seconds_bucket, grouped by (region, gpu_type, pool_type)
  - Panels show P50/P95 and a stacked breakdown of step duration share (based on fleet_provision_step_duration_seconds_bucket)
- Success rate
  - 1 - (sum(rate(fleet_provision_result_total{result="failure"}[30m])) / sum(rate(fleet_provision_result_total[30m])))
  - Secondary panel: failure reasons via fleet_provision_failure_total{reason=...} topk(10)
- Quarantine
  - fleet_readiness_state_total{state="Quarantined"} and rate of transitions into Quarantined (if transition metric present)

Alerts (initial thresholds)
NOTE: These are intentionally conservative. We expect to tune after the us-east A100-only staged rollout, once we have a week of data.
- Page: ProvisionToReadyTTRElevatedP95
  - Condition: P95 time-to-ready > 75m for 2h (per region+gpu_type, limited to dedicated pools)
  - Rationale: Catch systemic provisioning regressions (image bake issues, cluster join failures) without paging on small sample spikes.
- Ticket: ProvisionToReadyTTRElevatedP50
  - Condition: P50 time-to-ready > 35m for 6h
  - Rationale: Tracks gradual drift / capacity pressure; not an immediate incident.
- Page: ProvisionToReadySuccessRateLow
  - Condition: success rate < 97% over 1h AND total attempts > 30
  - Rationale: Prevents paging on low volume; aligns with early error budget policy.
- Ticket: ProvisionToReadyValidationFlakeRateHigh
  - Condition: retries per attempt > 1.5 over 6h OR NCCL smoke test failures exceed threshold
  - Rationale: Flake signal for follow-ups (timeouts/backoff, perf canary thresholds).
- Page: ProvisionToReadyQuarantineSpike
  - Condition: quarantined nodes added > 5 in 30m in a single region+gpu_type
  - Rationale: Potential fabric/driver/image issue; can translate directly to capacity shortfall.

Runbook annotations
All alerts include:
- dashboard: link placeholder (Grafana UID + path)
- runbook: runbook-links.md anchor (to be replaced with Confluence URL by Infra/SRE)
- owner: "infra-fleet" for provisioning issues; "sre" for alert delivery; "platform" when readiness service appears unhealthy

Screenshots
- (omitted) Grafana panels render in CI via dashboard lint; screenshots will be added once we have stable UIDs in the shared Grafana folder.

Testing / validation
- promtool check rules: pass
- grafana-dashboard-validator: pass
- jsonnet formatting: pass

Rollout plan
- Merge to main, then import dashboards to the shared Grafana folder (SRE-owned) during the us-east A100 staged rollout.
- Alerts will be deployed disabled-by-default (severity=none) for 48 hours; SRE will enable paging after confirming noise levels.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Confirm final SLO numbers after baseline metrics review (ENG-4821); these thresholds are based on initial baseline distributions and may shift.
- Confirm which metric is authoritative for "attempt" count (orchestrator vs readiness service).
- Replace runbook placeholders with the final Confluence runbook + dashboard URLs once those are finalized.

Links
- Linear: ENG-4827 (dashboards), ENG-4821 (SLOs/metrics)
- Related implementation PRs (metrics emission): redwood/pr-18441 (step breakdown metrics), redwood/pr-18475 (cardinality follow-up)

Commits
1) feat(dashboards): add provision-to-ready overview + step breakdown dashboards
2) feat(alerts): add initial ttr/success/quarantine alerts + recording rules
3) chore(ci): add grafana dashboard validation and promtool checks
4) docs: add runbook link stubs and dashboard import notes

Reviewer conversation (highlights)
- Allison Grant: Please ensure no per-node label usage, and keep dashboard variables bounded; can we add a hard note in the README about cardinality? Also, prefer recording rules for the percentile queries.
  - Sergio Costa: Updated dashboards to remove the node_id template var; added recording rules for ttr_p50/ttr_p95 by region/gpu_type/pool_type and added README note.
- Aisha Bello: The paging thresholds look aggressive for week 1; can we gate paging on attempt volume and require sustained breach? Also, please split ticket vs page for P50 vs P95.
  - Sergio Costa: Added attempt-volume guard (>30 attempts), changed P95 to 2h sustained, and added a separate P50 ticket with 6h window.
- Miles Thornton: Make sure the success rate calculation doesn’t double-count retries as failures; do we have a metric that represents final attempt outcome only?
  - Sergio Costa: Using fleet_provision_result_total emitted on terminal state only (success/failure). Added a comment in recording-rules.yaml to document this assumption.
- Vanessa Ortiz: Can we get a panel for "Validating stuck" specifically and a quarantine trend line? That’s what on-call needs when expansions stall.
  - Sergio Costa: Added "Validating age" panel (based on state gauge + time in state, where available) and quarantine trend line on Quarantine & flakes dashboard.

CI timeline
- 2025-10-11: promtool failed (unknown field `forEach` in rule group) -> fixed YAML schema, reran
- 2025-10-12: grafana validator failed (panel datasource UID unset) -> set datasource to ${DS_PROMETHEUS} and added CI default
- 2025-10-16: all checks green

Merge
Merged via squash on 2025-10-16.

Release notes
- Internal: Added initial Grafana dashboards + alert rules for Provision-to-Ready automation (time-to-ready, success rate, quarantine spike). Alerts ship disabled-by-default pending tuning during staged rollout.
